worth the money. the views are amazing. good location, bc game drives depart from there, and also you can do scenic drive as they have few animals in the area (as giraffe, wild boar, impalas and so on). guides were amaaazing (but it’s not from the hotel)!! food was also good, but no drinks (not even soft drinks) were included. the peanut butter milkshake was very tasty. we didn’t have any breakfast, because we did morning gave drive everyday, but they pack a good amount of food for you to take. Some of the staff looked like were not happy to work there, specially the recepction (even though they were helpful - we are saying that comparing to other places we stayed near kruger park). be aware that you’re staying in a tend, so you can expect to see insects inside of the tend, as the floor is a deck and no a proper floor. Bring extra clothes to wear, specially in winter, the room can be cold. the bathroom has no ceiling, so in case you want some privacy, there’s no option. they don’t have curtains to block the light, so if you sleep early or if you wake up late, might be a bit annoying.
